coaching.headline: Out-majored 16-22 and won on the back half — the 21.7 five-on-five at our inner tower flipped a Fangtooth-fed deficit into Primal, Orb and the base.
coaching.team: They owned the early objective game — Fangtooth at 9, 14 and 20 plus Mini Prime at 16, much of it bought by our solo deaths — then we won the fights that mattered: 5-3 at our inner tower at 21.7, 4-1 at our inhibitor at 27.8, 3-1 at 31. Seven won fights, four cashed (Primal 26, Orb and Genesis 30). The scar to learn from: 26.4 went 0-3 to Skylar alone at their outer tower — a better team doesn't hand the comeback window back.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 21.7-minute 5v5 win at our inner tower (5-3) stopped the bleed, and the 27.8 fight (4-1 defending our inhibitor) cashed into Orb Prime and the push that ended it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The duo lane won its read, but Murdock's 8 deaths were the tax that kept the enemy in it — three were solo catches (2.8 and 7.6 by Skylar, 19.6 by Wraith), and the film prices two of them at a Fangtooth each (8.6, 20.5). The carry line in the won fights was right; the deaths between fights were the leak.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel won the support read and put down 15 wards, and the 21.7 and 31 fight wins had the frontline to thank. Two notes: the 13.1 and 20.3 deaths each preceded a Fangtooth, and the build (Vainglory, Raiment, Stonewall) sat off the Xenia / Dynamo / Gaia Greaves meta core — on-core, the same fights get tankier.

loadout.name: Frenzied Fighter
loadout.text: Berserk has no cooldown and can remain on indefinitely while under the Health threshold.

ability.name: Berserk
ability.what: When Bayle drops below 35% of his Maximum Health, he enters Berserk for 7s.

loadout.plain: Once Bayle drops low, Berserk stays on with no cooldown, so its attack speed, move speed and crowd control resistance never run out. Built for brawling at low health instead of backing off.

loadout.name: Marrow
loadout.text: Heal for 6%/7%/8%/9% of damage dealt to Heroes, increased up to 15%/20%/25%/30% based on your Missing Health. (65% effectiveness for AoE attacks, 15% against monsters.)
loadout.plain: Heals Bayle off damage dealt to heroes, more the lower he is. Pairs with Dire Howl's healing and Berserk, so his low-health brawling keeps him alive longer.

loadout.name: Blood Bank
loadout.text: Store 100% of Hero damage as charges for 3s. Gain 0.75% Lifesteal per 100 charges.
loadout.plain: Big hits like Skull Crusher, Cursed Edge and Kingslayer store up charges that briefly add lifesteal, so his follow-up swings heal more right after a combo.

loadout.name: Jealousy
loadout.text: Deal 1%-8% increased damage as your Health falls from 100% to 20%.
loadout.plain: Bayle hits harder the lower his health gets, stacking with Berserk kicking in at low health. Rewards staying in the fight while hurt.

loadout.name: Eviscerator
loadout.text: Rending Strikes:  Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
loadout.plain: Activate to swing faster, heal off damage and add damage to basic attacks for a few seconds. Best right after Skull Crusher lowers the target's armor.
